summary: Intermittent inference stalls on text-generation endpoint due to throttling-feedback loop amplified by aggressive client retries
description: Issue summary: Starting 2026-03-13 09:10 UTC BrightCart reported sporadic stalls (requests hanging ~10-30s) and increased client-side retries against /v1/generate. Impact: user-facing slow searches and delayed order recommendations for ~15% of BrightCart traffic in us-east. Environment: Dedicated tenant on prod-us-east using pinned model redwood-v1.2 with reserved capacity. Observed: server-side 429 spikes coincident with client retry storms; many clients interpret 429/timeouts as network issues and immediately retry, creating a feedback loop that appears as latency regression. This ticket tracks triage and remediation for BrightCart and a preventative plan for other dedicated customers.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) From a client configured with low retry backoff (0-200ms), send bursts of concurrent requests to POST /v1/generate with typical BrightCart prompts (cart-summary, recommendation).
2) Observe an initial 429 from API gateway when quota window is reached or burst threshold exceeded.
3) Client immediately retries with no exponential backoff, generating more 429s and increasing queue times in the serving runtime.
4) The client sees perceived timeouts or long response times (10-30s) even though some requests eventually succeed after repeated retries.

comments: 2026-03-13 09:20 - Support (Alyssa): Received report from BrightCart CS about spikes in 'stalls' and perceived timeouts. Customer attached request traces and client logs showing aggressive retry behavior.

2026-03-13 09:35 - SRE (Ravi): Correlated API gateway 429s with sudden request-rate bursts from BrightCart's IP ranges. Serving runtime queues rose for ~7 minutes. Investigating rate-limiter config and quota enforcement logs.
2026-03-13 10:05 - BrightCart (Customer): We rolled out a client change last night that reduces retry backoff to 0-100ms for faster UX. We observe degradation after the rollout.

2026-03-13 11:00 - Support (Alyssa): Temporarily increased BrightCart's burst quota and configured per-tenant burst smoothing while we investigate. Asked customer to revert client retry change as immediate mitigation.

2026-03-13 13:12 - SRE (Ravi): Implemented short-term gateway rule to return Retry-After header on 429s and apply soft rate-limiting at edge for BrightCart to break feedback loop. Monitoring for improvements.
2026-03-14 08:40 - Engineering (Marta): Noted a potential gap in quota SDK docs; adding guidance for exponential backoff and a recommended retry window per customer tier.
investigation_notes: 09:30 UTC - Observed 3x normal burst rate from BrightCart for 3 minutes aligning with their client rollout window.
09:40 UTC - API gateway shows quota bucket depletion for brightcart-burst; bucket resets every 60s. Throttling enforcement immediately begins returning 429s without Retry-After previously.
10:00 UTC - Serving runtime queue depth climbed, but average token throughput remained within expected capacity; tail latencies increased due to head-of-line retry amplification.
10:30 UTC - Cross-checked billing/quotas: no billing miscalculation, enforcement matches configured tenant limits.
11:10 UTC - Confirmed lack of Retry-After header in earlier 429 responses. Edge change applied to include Retry-After and to issue 503 for brief windows to encourage client backoff.
11:45 UTC - Dashboard: request_success_rate for BrightCart recovered from 78%->95% after edge smoothing. Detailed graphs in: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/rtg/inference-tenant-brightcart

Hypothesis: Aggressive client retry backoff combined with burst quota semantics created a self-amplifying loop; clients kept resubmitting failing requests into a saturated quota window causing apparent latency/regression.
resolution_notes: - Increased BrightCart burst quota by 20% for 24 hours to reduce immediate 429s while customer reverts their client change.
- Edge rate-limiter patched to include Retry-After header and a soft cooldown per IP for repeated 429s to break retry loops.
- Support advised BrightCart to revert their client retry change and to implement exponential backoff (jitter recommended).
- (ENG-2641) Add per-tenant adaptive burst smoothing: allow transient overshoot while decaying over configurable window. (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2784)
- (DOCS-112) Update SDK and onboarding docs with recommended retry/backoff defaults for each customer_tier and a sample middleware that honors Retry-After.
- (OPS-789) Update quota runbook to explicitly document metrics to surface early retry storms and an automated alert that suggests temporary burst increases or edge cooling.
- Follow-up with BrightCart CSM to schedule an implementation review of their client-side retry logic.
